metas.name: Andalusia - Andalusia
metas.note:
Andalusia use the code A

But pay attention that :

  • A is also used for national roads that you can find everywhere in the country
  • A is also used in Aragon

However, the name of the region is wrote on the road markers (but not on the generic signs with cities name on it) for Andalusia (see attached pictures), but otherwise, don't search in Andalusiaif you have just a A-XXX road number.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Aragon - Aragon
metas.note:
Aragon use the code A.

But pay attention that :

  • A is also used for national roads that you can find everywhere in the country
  • A is also used in Andalusia

However, the name Andalusia is wrote on the road markers (but not on the generic signs with cities name on it). You can also use the fact that the signs (for those that have road numbers only) have black border in Aragon (check also the image of the sign attached here). Otherwise, don't search in Aragonif you have just a A-XXX road number, search for a confirmation first.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Region of Murcia - Region of Murcia
metas.note:
Region of Murcia use the code RM or MU

Be careful that the codes are sometimes swapped between the map and Street View (RM on SV and MU on the map, or the opposite), so if you have a community road number, search without giving to much trust into the map's codes, and more in the number itself for this region
